introduction: The atmosphere of abandonment in the Donbass is always present - the atmosphere of incessant decadence. Not despair as such, but all the days pass against the backdrop of some kind of struggle. Around the steppe and nature itself is inhospitable. First of all, it is an inhospitable space, which consists of factories.In fact, the short film "The Road Back" is two tickets "Kyiv-Alchevsk" and "Alchevsk-Kyiv". We walked with a friend around the city. Filmed. There was no script. I was making a film at the editing table. Wrote more than 20 versions of the text. I really like Andrey Platonov's prose. And with my text I wanted to get closer to its metaphorical nature. I sat and read poetry in prose. Therefore, the short film cannot be called a documentary - there is a lot tied to the word.
